items.headline: Angels fire pitching coach Mike Maddux, bullpen coach Dom Chiti
items.summary: The Angels, who have a staff ERA of 4.51 and an MLB-worst 508 walks, have fired pitching coach Mike Maddux, assistant Darryl Scott and bullpen coach Dom Chiti.

items.headline: Trump warns replacing FIFA chief Infantino would be 'terrible mistake'
items.summary: President Donald Trump said in a social media post Monday that ousting FIFA president Gianni Infantino would be a "terrible mistake."

items.headline: CBS Sports president: 'No timetable' on future of Romo after arrest
items.summary: CBS Sports president David Berson said on Tuesday that there is 'no timetable' on the future of NFL analyst Tony Romo following Romo's arrest on suspicion of operating a vehicle while under the influence.

items.headline: Raiders QB Mendoza 'will get plenty of reps' in preseason opener
items.summary: Raiders rookie QB Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 pick in April's NFL draft, "will get plenty of reps" in Thursday's preseason opener against the Cardinals, coach Klint Kubiak said.

items.headline: Jordan Spieth reaches FedEx Cup playoffs despite no top-10s
items.summary: Jordan Spieth reached the PGA Tour playoffs for the 14th year in a row, but this time he did it without finishing in the top 10 in any of his 21 tournaments.

items.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal eye move for Barcelona's Koundé

items.headline: Mason Mount (foot) a doubt for Man United friendly vs. Leeds
items.summary: Mason Mount is a doubt for Manchester United's preseason friendly against Leeds United in Dublin on Wednesday as he continues his recovery from a foot injury, sources have told ESPN.

items.headline: John McGinn: Aston Villa will compete despite big name departures

items.summary: Manchester City midfielder Kalvin Phillips has returned to Sheffield United on loan after an injury-affected spell last season.

items.headline: Newcastle boss Matthias Jaissle feels 'ambitious,' warns success won't happen 'overnight'

items.headline: Wilson signs 1-year deal with Brewers days after being waived
items.summary: Pitcher Bryse Wilson, who was designated for assignment by the Brewers on Saturday, is back with the team on a one-year deal.

items.headline: Blue Jays' Trey Yesavage has knee surgery; Jameson Taillon to IL
items.summary: Blue Jays right-hander Trey Yesavage had surgery to repair damage to his left meniscus on Tuesday, but the team isn't ruling him out for the season.

items.headline: Marlins place Kyle Stowers on 10-day IL with hamstring strain
items.summary: The Marlins placed first baseman/outfielder Kyle Stowers on the 10-day injured list on Tuesday with a left hamstring strain.
